recognize_zh: 低倍下幾乎每顆紅血球形狀都不同：橢圓形、淚滴狀、碎片與鋸齒狀細胞混雜，並有許多深染的小圓形紅血球或碎片，只有一顆嗜中性球，呈現嚴重的紅血球大小不等與異形。
features: Marked anisocytosis with admixed normal-sized, oval and very small red cells
Severe poikilocytosis: elliptocytes, teardrop cells, fragments and crenated/spiculated forms
Numerous small dense microspherocyte-like cells and fragments (some may be platelets)
Rare leukocytes; a single neutrophil in the field
Low-power view limits assessment of fine inclusions
describe_en: Low-power view of a peripheral blood smear shows severe red cell anisopoikilocytosis. There are numerous elliptocytes, teardrop cells, red cell fragments and spiculated forms, together with many small dense microspherocyte-like cells and fragments. Leukocytes are sparse, with a single neutrophil in the field. Fine red cell inclusions cannot be assessed at this magnification. In the context of a myelodysplastic neoplasm with complex karyotype, findings are consistent with marked dyserythropoietic red cell changes.

ddx.vs: MAHA shows predominant schistocytes with helmet forms and marked thrombocytopenia with hemolysis markers rather than a broad mixture of elliptocytes and teardrops.
HPP presents from childhood with extreme microcytosis, budding and fragments and abnormal thermal sensitivity/spectrin studies, not in an adult with clonal cytogenetics.
Myelofibrosis also shows teardrops but typically has leukoerythroblastosis, splenomegaly and reticulin fibrosis on marrow biopsy.
Iron deficiency shows hypochromic microcytes with pencil cells, lacking the dense microspherocytes and fragments seen here.
